text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Happiness has come! Fortune is here!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Everyone did amazingly, as I knew they
would!
Our will found a way!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
All the same, the Unity Cup isn't over
yet.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Let's dash to a shrine and pray for
victory in the
next round too!
